title: 第5章这是男人之间的事，暴揍唐三和小舞-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    小舞望着叶寒那冷漠到极致的眼神，下意识地往后退了一步。

    就在刚才，她感受到了一股冷厉的杀意，好像是有一把锋利的宝剑，架在她的脖子上。

    但她可不是吓大的。

    身为一只化形为人的十万年魂兽，她什么局势没有见过，岂会怕了一个跟她年纪差不多大的冷漠少年？

    “小舞，我平时怎么跟你说的，女孩子要矜持，不要动不动就打架。”

    “打架，是不能解决所有问题的。”

    “有我在，可轮不到你打架。”

    “这位兄弟，欺负女人不算什么本事。”

    唐三宠溺地揉了揉小舞的秀发，在看向叶寒的眼神中闪烁出无尽的冷意。

    他能感知到，叶寒是一个有实力的魂师，而且还极其危险。

    否则，他的眼神不可能如此冷漠，气息也不可能如此弑杀。

    若是让小舞跟他交手，会吃大亏，甚至还会被对方羞辱，受到伤害。

    与其看到小舞受辱，倒不如让他来顶在前面。

    他倒要瞧瞧，眼前的小子到底有多厉害。

    “小三，你小心点。”

    小舞感受到唐三的举动，心中一暖，愤怒的情绪逐渐平稳下来。

    “叶寒，我的事，不用你管。”

    “你让开！”

    虽然朱竹清对叶寒挺身而出的行为，多少有点感动，但她不是一个认怂的人，想要自己来应对。

    与同龄人交手，她从来没有怕过。

    眼前的唐三和小舞，年龄跟她差不多，实力能高到哪儿去。

    “这是男人之间的事，还轮不到你。”

    “你们俩一起上吧。”

    叶寒冷漠地回了一句，向唐三和小舞勾了勾挑衅的手指。

    如果不是他有底线，有自己的杀人规矩，看唐三和小舞年纪尚小，又没做伤天害理，天地难容的事情，否则他早就动杀心了。

    朱竹清感受着叶寒的气场，有点看呆了。

    这家伙也太霸道了。

    但她却觉得这种被袒护的感觉很不错。

    “小子，别以为你装成冷漠的样子，我们就怕你。”

    “小三，揍死他，把他揍成猪头。”

    小舞见叶寒要一打二，小瞧他们的实力，气得她直跺脚。

    都是同龄人，有什么好嘚瑟的，真把他们当普通软柿子捏了？

    “诸位，你们不能打架啊，这要是把东西打坏了，我的工作就没了，你们就行行好吧。”

    玫瑰酒店前台服务员看到眼前的一幕，赶紧跑出来阻止。

    这年头，找份工作不容易。

    可不能毁了他的工作。

    “小哥，这件事你不用管。”

    “这里的一切损失都算我们的。”

    “这是一张一千金魂币钱票，就先压在这里。”

    话落，朱竹清将一张钱票，拍在前台上。

    服务员看到钱票，双眼直冒精芒。

    这些钱，他可能一辈子都挣不到。

    “哼，有钱了不起啊。”

    小舞偷偷看了一眼钱票，有点羡慕地啐了一口。

    他们可真有钱。

    “请指教。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xiao Wu looked at Ye Han's extremely cold eyes and subconsciously took a step back.

Just now, she felt a cold killing intent, as if there was a sharp sword on her neck.

But she is not scared.

As a 100,000-year-old soul beast that took the form of a human, she had never seen any situation before. How could she be afraid of an indifferent young man about her age?

"Xiao Wu, as I usually tell you, girls should be reserved and not get into fights."

“Fighting cannot solve all problems.”

"As long as I'm here, it's not your turn to fight."

"This brother, bullying women is not a skill."

Tang San rubbed Xiao Wu's hair lovingly, and looked at Ye Han with endless coldness in his eyes.

He could sense that Ye Han was a powerful soul master, and he was also extremely dangerous.

"Otherwise, his eyes wouldn't be so cold, and his breath wouldn't be so murderous.

If Xiao Wu fights with him, he will suffer a big loss, and may even be humiliated and hurt by the other party.

Rather than seeing Xiao Wu being humiliated, it would be better for him to take the lead.

He wanted to see how powerful the boy in front of him was.

"Mistress, be careful."

Xiao Wu felt Tang San's actions, her heart warmed, and her angry mood gradually calmed down.

"Ye Han, you don't have to worry about my affairs."

"Get out of the way!"

Although Zhu Zhuqing was somewhat touched by Ye Han's step in coming forward, she was not a timid person and wanted to deal with it on her own.

She has never been afraid of playing against peers.

Tang San and Xiao Wu in front of her were about the same age as her, but how powerful could they be.

"This is a matter between men, it's not your turn yet."

"You two come together."

Ye Han replied coldly and raised a provocative finger at Tang San and Xiao Wu.

"If he didn't have a bottom line and his own rules for killing, seeing that Tang San and Xiao Wu were still young, and they didn't do anything that was harmful to the world and that would be intolerable, he would have been murderous long ago.

Zhu Zhuqing felt Ye Han's aura and was a little stunned.

This guy is too domineering.

But she felt that this feeling of being protected was very good.

"Boy, don't think that because you are pretending to be indifferent, we are afraid of you."

"Xiao San, beat him to death, beat him into a pig's head."

When Xiao Wu saw that Ye Han wanted to fight one against two and underestimated their strength, she was so angry that she stamped her feet.

They are all of the same age, so what’s the point of being so arrogant? Do you really treat them like ordinary weaklings?

"Everyone, you can't fight. If I break something, my job will be gone. Just do it."

The receptionist at the Rose Hotel saw what was happening and quickly ran out to stop him.

“It’s not easy to find a job these days.

We can't ruin his work.

"Brother, you don't have to worry about this."

“All losses here are ours.”

"This is a ticket for one thousand gold soul coins, just press it here first."

After finishing speaking, Zhu Zhuqing slapped a money ticket on the front desk.

When the waiter saw the money ticket, his eyes shone brightly.

He may not be able to earn this money in his lifetime.

"Humph, being rich is amazing."

Xiao Wu secretly glanced at the money ticket and spat in envy.

They are really rich.

"Please advise."
